emails.subject: 🎤 AFRO-AMERICAN SOCIETY x SOYEYA x ROCKAPELLAS FRIENDSGIVING SHOW!!! 🎤
emails.body_text:
Who wants to give back? We do.
Your Friendsgiving energy just entered the chat — and it’s all about community, gratitude, and good vibes.

🎤 AFRO-AMERICAN SOCIETY x SOYEYA x ROCKAPELLAS FRIENDSGIVING SHOW!!! 🎤

🗓 Sunday, Nov 16
🕗 8 PM
📍 Top of the Hop (TOH)

This Friendsgiving, we’re giving back. The Afro-American Society and Soyeya are partnering to raise funds for hurricane relief in Jamaica after the devastating impact of Hurricane Melissa.
We’re urging everyone to show support by donating here:
👉 https://www.globalempowermentmission.org/mission/hurricane-melissa/
(QR code also on the flyer!)

Your donations will directly support emergency aid, shelter, and recovery efforts for families impacted by the hurricane in Jamaica.

Meanwhile, The Rockapellas, in light of the recent funding cuts to the SNAP Program and in time for the holidays, will be collecting non-perishable food items from 4 PM until showtime at the Top of the Hop, as well as monetary donations via QR code.
All proceeds go directly to LISTEN Community Services Food Pantry to support our Upper Valley community.

We hope to see you there :)

Sincerely,
AFRO-AMERICAN SOCIETY

emails.subject: Register for 26W Sorority Recruitment!
emails.body_text:
[IMG_5554.jpeg]26W sorority recruitment is officially open!

What does this mean? And how can I sign up?

In order to rush, you must REGISTER ONLINE BY DECEMBER 21st AT 9PM EST:
DartmouthISC.mycampusdirector2.com<http://dartmouthisc.mycampusdirector2.com/>

In addition to online registration, you must fulfil the following requirements. Please note that the information session and the rest of these requirements will occur AFTER the deadline for online registration.

  1.
Attend an information session
  2.
$35 registration fee. This will be taken from your DASH account, so please make sure you have the money in your account ahead of time.

  1.
Please contact us for full financial assistance

  1.
StandUp to Hazing Completion (asynchronous training video)
  2.
First Year Sexual Violence Prevention Project (SVPP)
  3.
Good academic status (2.5 GPA or higher)
  4.
Sophomore status (transfer students CAN go through recruitment)
  5.
BI-2 Completion


Six sororities will be participating in recruitment:

  1.
Alpha Xi Delta
  2.
Chi Delta
  3.
Kappa Delta
  4.
Kappa Delta Epsilon
  5.
Sigma Delta
  6.
Kappa Kappa Gamma


Again, online registration is due by December 21st at 9pm EST.

We will be sending out more information shortly about the following requirements. If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to inter.sorority.council@dartmouth.edu.

Warmly,
The ISC

emails.subject: GREEN KEY ARTIST SURVEY - FILL OUT NOW!!!!
emails.body_text:
Hey y’all!!


While finals season may have you in the trenches, PB is already planning away for the spring.


So with that in mind… IT'S THAT TIME OF YEAR FOLKS!


[https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTRhYzcxNzJmaG02ZWN5bWo4eDNpanF2NWtnb200OGM1YmY2NXA2dnVhZ2Z0NXRpdSZlcD12MV9naWZzX3NlYXJjaCZjdD1n/DPznISmq0hLRQqG71g/200.gif]


It is time to fill out the Green Key Artist Survey! This survey differs from the initial genre survey, as it allows us to better understand your input! We want your feedback, and we know you’ve got questions too!!


First off, have any burning questions about all things Green Key? Please check out this amazing website, which is a great resource for insight to our process. If you are curious about the results of our last survey about genre preferences/interests, they can also be found here.


https://sites.google.com/dartmouth.edu/gk-faqs/home?authuser=0


But now, what you have all been waiting for…


SURVEY TIME!!!

TAKE THE SURVEY<https://sites.google.com/dartmouth.edu/gk-faqs/home?authuser=0>

TAKE THE SURVEY<https://sites.google.com/dartmouth.edu/gk-faqs/home?authuser=0>

TAKE THE SURVEY<https://sites.google.com/dartmouth.edu/gk-faqs/home?authuser=0>


If you’d like to think through your options before completing the survey, take some time to listen to this SPOTIFY PLAYLIST<https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3ac8hKzSNSEseaUiFaY6S0?si=88da3732485d45ea> <https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3ac8hKzSNSEseaUiFaY6S0?si=88da3732485d45ea> we made for you. (Please note this includes options for both the headliner and opener)


BUT PLEASE NOTE: The survey will close MONDAY, DECEMBER 1st. And to preface again this is a NEW SURVEY. If you do not take our surveys, we have no way of knowing what you want. Thank you in advance for taking the time to listen to the different artists and completing the survey.


Finally… you can come to our winter meetings any/every Wednesday at 5:30pm in Collis 303 if you want to get involved with planning Green Key or other fun events :)


Get hype


💚PB

emails.subject: LAST CU VINE TN
emails.body_text:
Studying for finals gotcha down?
Leaving you with a pretty sad frown :(
Let’s be honest, although we are striving
If GPA stood for “God Please Assist,” we’d be thriving.
[This Is Fine GIFs | Tenor]
What you really need is Jesus and food
Which, by the way, puts me in a good mood!
But where to go? Where to be?
WELL I’LL TELL YA AND I’LL SHOUT IT WITH GLEE!!
[Cheer Baby GIFs | Tenor]
No need to strive, no need to race,
Just bring your heart to this wonderful place.
Just in town, right next to Bean’s Art Store
You’ll have a blast with FUNS GALORE!!
[New trending GIF tagged love funny dance happy… | Trending Gifs]
So come at 5:30, don’t delay,
Let Jesus wash your cares away!

emails.subject: Crumbs & Creations 🍪 TONIGHT @ 10PM at One Wheelock
emails.body_text:
Hey Party People! ⭐

We made it to the final Collis After Dark 🌙 weekend of the term, cue the confetti 🎊 and the cozy sweaters 🧣. Before the library 💡 glow turns into full exam mode 📝, CAD is throwing one last delicious, low‑pressure 😉 duo to help you decompress, laugh 😂, snack, and recharge. Two nights 🌆, zero grading 0️⃣, 100% restorative🔋.


TONIGHT
CRUMBS & CREATIONS 🍪
[cid:d2db4412-3c27-487a-9d34-020dc15f510a]
Friday, November 14th | 10:00PM | One Wheelock
Decorate your own cookies from Katie’s Cookies, construct (and aggressively accessorize) gingerbread houses, and unleash your inner pastry architect. Whether you’re a frosting minimalist or a candy maximalist, this is the sweetest way to start the weekend. Supplies and toppings are limited - arrive early for your kit and your best decorating station. 🍬 🏚 🍪


TOMORROW NIGHT
RECHARGE 🔋
[cid:896544b5-bfb2-459e-964c-00685c673407]
Saturday, November 15th | 10:00PM | Collis Common Ground
The ultimate chill lab: crafts, board games, ramen, tea, low‑key music, and comfy seating to help you catch your breath before finals. Come knit a little calm into the term, play a slow game with friends, or just sit with a warm bowl of noodles and recharge your brain batteries. 🍵 🍜 🧠



Stay excited, hyped, and ready for a weekend accompanied with Cookies, Ramen Noodles, and Vibes! We can’t wait to see you this Weekend🥂


❤️,
Your Friends at Collis After Dark

emails.subject: THEME REVEAL: Winter Carnival Will See You Now!!!
emails.body_text:

But this year, think more tornado🌪️ and less typhoon…

Idina Menzel holds it in quite high esteem

What is This Feeling? It feels like a  dream !

emails.subject: Fall Finale for the Class of 2029: Tuesday, Nov 18!
emails.body_text:
Hey 29s!


Want to end the term with some chill time before studying begins?

Need some snacks or resources for finals?

Stop by Collis Common Ground between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m. on Tuesday, November 18 for …
[Fall Finale logo 2029 against mult-colored trees]

Enjoy Lou’s donuts and connect with your classmates before heading
into the finals period.

We’ll also have after-school snacks to go – stock up on goodies to fuel the week!

Decorate a postcard (that we’ll send it on your behalf if you want), do a little bit of decompressing through coloring and sculpting Play Doh,
or take some origami with you for when you need a mindful moment.
Along with your friends in New Student Orientation,
you also have the chance to connect with:
Academic Skills Center: tools and resources for finals preparation!
Your Class Council: goodie bags and well wishes!
Undergraduate Deans: check in with a dean ahead of finals
and your next term at Dartmouth
… and more!


Take a break with us and your classmates!
See Dartmouth Groups<https://dartmouthgroups.dartmouth.edu/nso/rsvp_boot?id=1626733> for more details.

Tuesday, November 18

4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m.

Collis Student Center, Common Ground

See you there!!!!

________________________________
